public_summary_note: Selected fields from the original acceptance record. Operational host details and internal workflow records are omitted. This is not a new proof replay.
qualifications: Supplied-proof correspondence is accepted with validated larger nonsharp fixed-particle constants. The manuscript smaller displayed constants are not certified.

The formal geometry uses coordinate cuts, signed-boundary cancellation and Brunn-Minkowski/coarea. The original geometric argument was validated separately; it was not formalized verbatim and was not waived.
The Hilbert-space substitution was reviewed at the local and material exact-pin scope; no whole-Mathlib audit is claimed.
Stage05 is an independent AI semantic/evidence review with reported role separation. It is not human certification, a new kernel run, or independent OS administration.

Candidate and challenge modules were rebuilt from source for each required replay. Existing protected official dependency artifacts were reused after 144206 manifest entries, 15 tools and 11 native-boundary inputs were checked.
No VM reboot or whole dependency rebuild was performed. Stage06 performs identity checks and archival, not a new protected theorem replay.
Twenty-seven solution .olean files varied with embedded build paths; source and proof-export hashes matched. General build-byte determinism is not claimed.
Two UTC-versus-monotonic timing discrepancies remain documented. Resource enforcement and runtime-limit conclusions use the retained monotonic evidence; the cause of clock drift is not certified.

Two intentional missing-target exports emitted PANIC while returning zero. Mandatory-target Comparator rejection and the surrounding negative-control evidence, rather than exporter status alone, established rejection.
The global scheduler daemon-failure/orphan-pruner combination was not newly certified. Existing locks, routing and campaign ownership were preserved.
An isolation errno of ENOENT records a hidden path, not a permissions-visible EACCES. Both observed mechanisms deny the tested writes; actual errno records are retained.
A phase-helper exception may skip that phase immediate post-baseline check. The reviewed failure boundary and final full protected readback are retained.
The protected manifest retains its registration-time historical eligibility labels. Final acceptance is a separate owner metadata record bound to the unchanged manifest.

Nine complete disposable build/cache archives remain local with exact current hashes. The cloud set includes all reproducible source, all reviews, commands, receipts, build manifests and every unique raw proof export; no full VM/dependency binary image is claimed.
